scripts.build: pnpm prepare:pyodide && pnpm typecheck && vite build --mode viewer --config app/server/src/export/configuration.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json playwright.config.ts .devcontainer app infra dashboard tests
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .oxlintrc.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json playwright.config.ts .devcontainer app infra dashboard tests
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p app/shared && tsc -p app/server && tsc -p app/client && tsc -p infra && tsc -p tests
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
